purpose: C17/C8 replay-engine draft: the R2 plan plus complete, path-safe adapters for all 18 external branch producers, a declared isolated environment, and the registration interface for C2/C4/C6/C7

root_contract.path_rule: all input and output paths resolve from the two explicit CLI roots; __file__ is never used to resolve an output path
root_contract.signed_tree_write_rule: no path under the signed analysis tree is written; the launcher snapshots runs/code/config/reports/verifier before and after and refuses to emit a manifest if any of them changed
root_contract.sandbox_rule: every external producer runs inside <out>/sandbox/<stage> as its own root; reads outside the sandbox + interpreter environment are refused at the audit-hook level, writes outside the sandbox are refused; declared outputs are collected under <out>/branches/<stage>/
root_contract.numeric_replay_note: cache drivers run with <ANALYSIS_ROOT>/recovered/c17_replay_env/venv-cpu-replay/bin/python (rebuild_env.sh installs it)

empty_output_assertion.rule: refuse when the target output directory exists and is non-empty
empty_output_assertion.resume_policy: no in-place resume: a crashed run is preserved and re-run into a new empty directory; the old partial directory is never silently reused, never bulk-copied and never auto-deleted by the launcher

forbidden_computation_input_patterns.explicit_reason: an earlier run's final values must never be a computation input: *_final* and *_summary* files are terminal values, metrics.json/report.json are earlier-run results or producer reports; a fresh run must recompute from declared observations, declared frozen derived inputs, or declared accepted cache members
enforcement: config load refuses any whitelist entry matching a forbidden pattern
every resolved input path is checked before any read
executor self-test T3 covers forbidden paths, clean paths and config-load refusal
